## Void Deck 0.2.2 — lighter and easier on the battery

A performance release. Nothing changes visually.

- **Cheaper Home animation.** The light sweep across the dot grid is now handled by the GPU instead of being redrawn every frame, and it rests between passes. On my Deck it went from about 21% to 7% of a CPU core.
- **Paused while you play.** The Home animation stops whenever a game is running, so it never competes with the game in the background.
- **No more background process.** Void Deck no longer ships an unused Python backend, so Decky doesn't start (or have to kill) an extra process, and restarts are faster.
- **Half the download.** The release zip dropped from 227 KB to 120 KB.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from URL*, and paste the link to `VoidDeck-v0.2.2.zip` below. It replaces the previous version.
